summary: Frontend-only validation of the mobile hamburger menu on /inscricao-realizada and /pagamento-pix headers (open shadow DOM injected by /seduc/seduc-theme.js). All assertions pass on mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x800), plus regression on 4 other pages.
critical_code_review_comments: seduc-theme.js hard-codes the shadow-host at top of body and relies on document-level click listener to close the menu. Since the burger lives inside an open shadow root, the outside document click properly closes it — verified. OK.
No horizontal overflow at 390px — OK. Burger is visible, big green 'Minhas inscrições' button is hidden via CSS @media (max-width:768px) a.minhas{display:none!important}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header is injected into open shadow root on #seduc-header-host. Playwright's page.locator pierces open shadow DOM automatically — selectors like [data-testid="header-menu-toggle"] work directly. Verified: mobile 390x844 -> hamburger visible, big btn hidden, menu toggles open/close via burger click, outside click closes, link navigates to /minhas-inscricoes.html. Desktop 1920x800 -> big btn visible, hamburger hidden. Regression pages /inscricao.html, /dados-inscricao.html, /confirmacao show Início/Concursos (Sair hidden on mobile) and no hamburger; /minhas-inscricoes.html has no nav/hamburger — matches spec.
